lackawanna-college.status: Conference participant, NCAA DII membership pending
lackawanna-college.note: Competes in PSAC schedules during 2026–27; NCAA DII membership application process begins 2027–28. Do not count as a certified DII opponent yet.

loyola-university-new-orleans.note: Gulf South Conference membership begins July 1, 2027; not a 2026–27 DII member.

monroe-university.status: CACC participant, NCAA DII application pending
monroe-university.note: Begins CACC competition in 2026–27 but has not completed admission to NCAA Division II. Ineligible for league postseason during transition.

texas-wesleyan-university.note: Remains NAIA through 2027–28 if transition proceeds; 2028–29 is proposed first Division II season.

texas-a-m-university-texarkana.note: Accepted into DII reclassification process effective 2026; LSC conference membership begins July 1, 2027. Championship eligibility differs from regular-season games.
